inputs.description: Inputs into the workflow that is being optimized

optimizations.description: The optimizations to run during the {@link #optimize} of this optimization strategy.

title:
The {@link Workflow.OptimizationStrategy} defines an interface for all optimization strategies to use with {@link Workflow#optimize}. The
responsibility of an optimization strategy is to coordinate the dependencies and execution order (and count) for a list of
{@link Workflow.Optimization}. An optimization strategy can make these determinations based off of, for example,
an optimization latency vs estimated optimization benefit trade-off.
Note that an optimization strategy itself is a {@link Workflow.Optimization} and is therefore composable/reusable in other
optimization strategies.
name: Workflow.OptimizationStrategy
